cases.name: position-prior-nested
cases.notes: Fixed in m2.1 (§10): position_prior is over the sibling count, not the flattened list size. A five-item list (ten-token items) where the second and fourth items have two adjacent mid-item tokens changed (text_sim 0.5 each) and two paragraphs are inserted above the list. The list carries by context and the three untouched items lock, so both edited items reach phase 5 with neighbor_ctx 1 and parent_match 1: score = 0.275 + 0.15 + 0.10 + 0.10 × position_prior. Each item keeps its index among five siblings, so the sibling-count prior is 1 and both score 0.625 ≥ 0.62 and carry. Under the m2.0 prior (index / (|flattened| − 1), 6 old blocks vs 8 new) the priors were 0.943 and 0.829, scores 0.619 and 0.608, and both items minted.
